entries.summary: Fixed Google sign-in: added port 5174 to CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS. User also needs to add http://localhost:5174 to Google Cloud Console authorized origins.
entries.details: settings.py CORS was missing port 5174 (Ignite dev server). Google Cloud Console origins need http://localhost:5174 added. Backend GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID matches frontend VITE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.
decisions: Added port 5174 to CORS
User must also update Google Cloud Console origins

entries.summary: Full-stack Arabic clinic management system with Django REST backend + React frontend. Completed: models, auth, CRUD, doctor schedule, appointment booking with available slots.
entries.details: Backend: Django 5.2, DRF, SimpleJWT, django-filter, Pillow. Models: Custom User (doctor/patient roles), Doctor, DoctorSchedule, Patient, Appointment, MedicalRecord. Frontend: React 19, Vite 8, Tailwind v4, React Router v7, Axios with JWT auto-refresh. All Arabic RTL UI.
decisions: Removed departments system entirely; each doctor has icon (ImageField) instead
DoctorSchedule model for weekly available time slots with unique_together constraint
Register flow: checkbox 'I am a doctor' -> conditional fields (specialization/fee/bio vs age/gender)
Dashboard booking shows available slots from backend endpoint based on date selection
MySchedule page (doctor-only sidebar nav) for managing weekly time slots
Frontend dev server proxies /api to http://127.0.0.1:8000

entries.summary: Multiple bug fixes and major error handling overhaul: Dashboard rewritten to show department tables with doctors, RegisterSerializer `department` field fix (AssertionError), API URL fixes in frontend, seed data rewrite with realistic Arabic data, notification system built, error handling moved from toasts to inline divs.
entries.details: BUG FIXES: 1) Dashboard rewritten - shows department tables with expandable doctor list; 2) RegisterSerializer department IntegerField was declared but missing from Meta.fields → AssertionError on POST /api/register/; 3) Doctors.jsx, Appointments.jsx were using /api/ prefix incorrectly (axios baseUrl already /api/); 4) /api/users/ endpoint doesn't exist - removed from Doctors.jsx; 5) RegisterSerializer did not pass department to Doctor creation. ERROR HANDLING: getApiError utility fixed to check data.detail/data.error before status codes; getLoginError provides specific messages (401→اسم المستخدم أو كلمة المرور غير صحيحة); all pages converted from error toasts to inline error divs; NotificationContext - errors persist until clicked, success/warning/info auto-dismiss in 4s. SEED DATA: 7 departments, 52 doctors with realistic Arabic names, Egyptian phone numbers, realistic consultation fees; 155 DoctorSchedule entries created.
decisions: Dashboard now shows department tables (not stats/charts layout)
Errors shown as inline divs that stay until form resubmit; toasts only for success
getApiError checks data.detail/data.error first, then status codes
Error toasts persist until clicked (not auto-dismiss)
Seed data uses realistic Arabic names and Egyptian phone numbers (01xxxxxxxxx)
Frontend never uses /api/ prefix in axios calls (baseUrl is /api/)
Register flow: department field properly included in serializer create()

entries.summary: Fixed RegisterSerializer AssertionError: `department` field was declared but missing from Meta.fields. Added 'department' to the fields list, verified backend check (0 issues) and frontend build pass.
entries.details: Applied one-line fix: added 'department' to RegisterSerializer.Meta.fields. Both backend `python manage.py check` (0 silenced) and frontend `npm run build` pass cleanly.
decisions: Added 'department' to Meta.fields to match declared field on serializer

entries.summary: Replaced old Dashboard.jsx with professional medical dashboard using reusable components: StatsCard, AppointmentTable, RecentPatients, RevenueChart, WeeklyChart, NotificationPanel.
entries.details: New Dashboard imports 6 reusable dashboard components. Stats cards show patients, appointments, doctors, revenue, waiting patients. Doctor search with filter by department. Booking modal with available time slots from backend. Uses react-icons/hi2 for stat icons.
decisions: Uses 5 StatsCards: Total Patients, Today's Appointments, Doctors on Duty, Revenue Today, Waiting Patients
Doctor search grid with avatar/initials, specialization, department, availability status, Book Now button
Charts row: RevenueChart + WeeklyChart side by side
Tables row: AppointmentTable + RecentPatients side by side
NotificationPanel at bottom
Booking modal persists with date picker + slot selection + reason input
